command.name: memo
command.sql:
select memo_id , case when encrypted = true then '암호화된 게시물' else title end as title , case when encrypted = true then title else '' end as encrypted_title , to_char(memo.update_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as update_date , encrypted
, category
, project.name as project_name from ${prop.table_name} as memo left outer join ${prop.project_table_name} as project on memo.project_id = project.project_id
from ${prop.table_name} as memo
where memo.parent_id is null
and memo.insert_id = ?
and exists ( select * from ${prop.user_role_table_name} _a inner join ${prop.user_role_table_name} _b on _a.${prop.role_name_column_name} = _b.${prop.role_name_column_name} and _b.${prop.login_name_column_name} = ? where _a.${prop.login_name_column_name} = memo.insert_id )
and memo.category = ?
and memo.project_id = ?
and ( title like '%' || REGEXP_REPLACE(?, '^\s+|\s+$', '', 'g') || '%' or contents like '%' || REGEXP_REPLACE(?, '^\s+|\s+$', '', 'g') || '%' or exists ( select * from ${prop.table_name} as memo_child where memo_child.parent_id = memo.memo_id and (title like '%' || REGEXP_REPLACE(?, '^\s+|\s+$', '', 'g') || '%' or contents like '%' || REGEXP_REPLACE(?, '^\s+|\s+$', '', 'g') || '%')
and insert_id = ?
and exists ( select * from ${prop.user_role_table_name} _a inner join ${prop.user_role_table_name} _b on _a.${prop.role_name_column_name} = _b.${prop.role_name_column_name} and _b.${prop.login_name_column_name} = ? where _a.${prop.login_name_column_name} = memo_child.insert_id )
) )
order by memo.insert_date desc
